fieldValues.title: Serve the registry over streamable HTTP with identity from outside the engine
fieldValues.move: Add rmcp transport-streamable-http-server behind a Cargo feature in srs-mcp, bound to loopback by default, over the unchanged srs-mcp-core. The server accepts an identity assertion from a trusted front (Tailscale or identity-aware proxy, forward-auth header, or a static token file) and maps it to the session Actor. Each identity is handed its own RFC-049 registry, with read-only entries where it may not write. Amend ADR-037; no RFC, since transport is outside the standard. First dogfood in srs-lab: serve srs-context and srs-programme read-only to cloud routines instead of cloning.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Public MCP clients that need spec OAuth discovery (RFC 9728): the relay stays that front. Cross-repository relations (federation step 2).
fieldValues.falsifier: A client that cannot send a bearer header or sit behind the proxy, or an identity that must be decided per record rather than per registry.
fieldValues.return_when: A second server resolves a remote locator, or a non-agent client needs REST.
